desc: Vertigo effect. Dread without moving the subject.
verdict: RENDERED 2026-08-04. THIS MOVE DOES NOTHING. short.py fx_chain() has no branch for dolly_zoom, so the emitted filter chain is empty and the clip is passed through unchanged: mean absolute pixel difference against static is EXACTLY 0.00, both over the still keyframe and over a real generated clip, and all four displacement axes read +0px. compile.py downgrades a non-ready camera to static with a warning, but a hand-authored films/*.json bypasses compile.py and reaches short.py, where beat.camera is appended to the fx list and then silently matches nothing. Asked of the video model instead, LTX destroys the shot - the street collapses into unrecognisable abstract geometry by the halfway point (activity 13.79, the highest in the entire sweep). Neither route delivers a dolly zoom. See dolly_zoom.mp4 (identical to static.mp4) and dolly_zoom_prompted.mp4.
